newsitem.title: THAILAND: PTT Exploration makes gas find at Amarit-1 well.
newsitem.headline: PTT Exploration makes gas find at Amarit-1 well.

text.p: Thailand's PTT Exploration & Production Co Ltd Exploration and Production on Monday said it discovered a new gas find at the Amarit-1 in the Thai-Malaysia Joint Development Area.
The tests had a combined gas flow rate of 8.0 million cubic feet per day and 326 barrels per day of condensate, PTT Exploration said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

The appraisal drilling of Amarit-1 well was conducted by Carigali-PTTEPI Operating Company Sendirian Berhard (CPOC), it said. The well is located about 268 km (167.5 miles) off Thailand's southern province of Songkla and 171 km (107 miles) off Malaysia's northeastern Kota Bharu in Kelantan state.

The Thai-Malaysia JDA is a joint petroleum project in the Gulf of Thailand between PTTEP International Co Ltd, a unit of PTT Exploration, and Petronas Crigali Sendirian Berhad of Malaysia, the company said.
